strings: After the ash finally clears from m_c's lungs, r_c0 talks to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} about the lingering cough that might never leave.
r_c0 has noticed that while m_c is breathing easier, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/appear/appears} to have a lingering cough.
m_c's relief to have a clear chest is offset by the cough that still refuses to leave {PRONOUN/m_c/object} in peace.
